description: Sends an email through Salesforce with options for recipients, attachments, and activity logging. Check the returned action success status and errors to determine whether Salesforce accepted the request.

attachment_ids.description: IDs of files to attach. Provide ContentVersion (068...), Document (015...) Ids, or ContentDocument (069...) IdsCan be a comma-delimited string or a list.
attachment_ids.human_parameter_description: Files you want to attach to the email, referenced by their Salesforce IDs. You can provide one or more IDs (068..., 015..., or 069...) as a comma-separated string or a list.
attachment_ids.title: Attachment Ids

bcc_addresses.description: BCC email addresses. Can be a comma-delimited string or a list.
bcc_addresses.human_parameter_description: Recipients who get a private copy of the email. Other recipients won't see these addresses; enter one or more or a comma-separated list.
bcc_addresses.title: Bcc Addresses

examples:
Hi John,

Just a reminder about our meeting tomorrow at 2 PM.
Thank you for your time today. Attached is the proposal we discussed.
body.human_parameter_description: The main content of your email. Write your message here; include line breaks or HTML if needed.
body.title: Body

cc_addresses.description: CC email addresses. Can be a comma-delimited string or a list.
cc_addresses.human_parameter_description: People you want to keep in the loop. They will receive a copy of the email; enter one or more addresses or a comma-separated list.
cc_addresses.title: Cc Addresses

is_html.description: Whether the email body is HTML formatted.
is_html.human_parameter_description: Turn this on if your email body contains HTML formatting (like bold text, links, or paragraphs). Leave it off for plain-text messages.
is_html.title: Is Html

log_email.description: Whether to log the email on the recipient's activity timeline. Requires correct recipient_id and related_record_id values; incorrect IDs silently log the activity against the wrong records.
log_email.human_parameter_description: Choose whether to automatically log this email to the recipient's activity timeline. Turn this on to keep a record in Salesforce.
log_email.title: Log Email

org_wide_email_address_id.description: Org-Wide Email Address Id to use when sender_type is OrgWideEmailAddress.
org_wide_email_address_id.human_parameter_description: If sending from a shared company address, provide its Salesforce Org-Wide Email Address ID. This ensures the email comes from that approved address.
org_wide_email_address_id.title: Org Wide Email Address Id

recipient_id.description: ID of a lead, contact, or person account to send the email to. Used for logging and merge fields.
recipient_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce ID of the person you are emailing (Lead, Contact, or Person Account). This helps log the email and lets merge fields pull in their details.
recipient_id.title: Recipient Id

related_record_id.description: ID of a related record (e.g., Account, Opportunity, Case) for logging and merge fields.
related_record_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce ID of the record you want to relate this email to (such as an Account, Opportunity, or Case). Use this to have the email appear on that record's timeline and enable related merge fields.
related_record_id.title: Related Record Id

sender_address.description: Organization-wide email address. Required only when sender_type is OrgWideEmailAddress.
sender_address.human_parameter_description: If you don't know the ID, enter the actual org-wide email address (for example, noreply@company.com). We'll try to look up the correct ID for you.
sender_address.title: Sender Address

sender_type.human_parameter_description: Choose who the email is sent from. Use 'CurrentUser' to send as yourself or 'OrgWideEmailAddress' to send from a shared company address.
sender_type.title: Sender Type

subject.human_parameter_description: What the email is about. Keep it clear so recipients quickly understand your message.
subject.title: Subject

to_addresses.description: Email addresses of recipients. Can be a comma-delimited string or a list. Recipients with null email fields generate per-recipient errors without failing the entire call; filter out null-email records beforehand.
to_addresses.human_parameter_description: Who you want to email. Enter one or more email addresses; you can provide a single address, a comma-separated list, or a list of addresses.
to_addresses.title: To Addresses

name: send_email

EmailError.description: Error details from a failed email send action.

fields.description: Array of field names that caused or are related to the error. Empty array if no specific fields are involved.
fields.title: Fields

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong.
message.title: Message

statusCode.description: Error status code identifying the type of error (e.g., 'UNKNOWN_EXCEPTION', 'INVALID_TYPE_ON_FIELD_IN_RECORD').
statusCode.title: Status Code

EmailError.title: EmailError

SendEmailResponse.description: Response from the Salesforce emailSimple action.

actionName.description: The name of the action that was invoked. Returns 'emailSimple' for the send email action.
actionName.title: Action Name

errors.description: Array of error objects containing details about any failures. Null when the action succeeds.
errors.title: Errors

invocationId.description: Identifier for tracking this specific action invocation. May be null.
invocationId.title: Invocation Id

isSuccess.description: Indicates whether the email was successfully accepted for sending. True means Salesforce accepted the request; false indicates failure.
isSuccess.title: Is Success

outputValues.description: Contains output values from the action. Typically null or empty for emailSimple as it doesn't return specific data. Null when the action fails.
outputValues.title: Output Values

sortOrder.description: Used for ordering multiple action responses in batch operations.
sortOrder.title: Sort Order

version.description: Version number of the action response format.
version.title: Version

SendEmailResponse.title: SendEmailResponse
